reasoning: Hantavirus vaccines have no candidate in or near Phase 3 trials in the US, and the disease's low incidence and lack of commercial incentive make it extremely unlikely that full FDA approval will be achieved by end-2026. The current pipeline (e.g., USAMRIID's DNA vaccines) is years away from submission. I estimate a true probability of ≤0.2% for this event, far below the market's implied 8.5%.
evidence_points: No Hantavirus vaccine has ever entered a US-based Phase 3 trial.
The FDA currently lists zero Hantavirus vaccines among its licensed products.
Rare disease and low commercial viability deter major investment; the most advanced US candidate (DNA vaccine) has not publicly progressed beyond early-phase studies.
End-of-2026 deadline leaves less than two years for completion of pivotal trials and regulatory review.
sources_consulted: FDA Vaccines Licensed for Use in the United States
ClinicalTrials.gov search for Hantavirus vaccine candidates
